utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: Good morning to everybody in and around the courtroom. Mr. Registrar, will you please call the case.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Good morning, Your Honours. Good morning to everyone in and around the courtroom. This is case number IT-04-81-T, The Prosecutor versus Momcilo Perisic. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: Thank you so much. Could we have the appearances for today starting with the Prosecution.

utterances.speaker: MR. HARMON
utterances.text: Good morning, Your Honours. Good morning, counsel, everyone in the courtroom. Mark Harmon, Salvatore Cannata, and Carmela Javier for the Prosecution.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: Thank you so much and for the Defence.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Good morning, Your Honours. Good morning to everyone in the courtroom. Mr. Perisic is represented in the courtroom today by Deirdre Montgomery; Tina Drolec; Milos Androvic; case manager, Daniela Tasic; and Defence counsel, Gregor Guy-Smith, and counsel Novak Lukic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: Thank you so much. May the Chamber please move into closed session.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: We're back in open session, Your Honours.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: Thank you so much. Mr. Harmon, you indicated that you don't have any more witnesses for the rest of the week.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: Shall we then -- is it correct then that we may postpone to the 31st of August?

utterances.speaker: MR. HARMON
utterances.text: I believe that is correct, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: That would be in Courtroom II at 9.00 in the morning. Court adjourned.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: to be reconvened on Monday, the 31st day of August, 2009, at 9.00 a.m.

procedural_notes.text: --- Whereupon the hearing adjourned at 12.06 p.m.,
